title: C:ecology-with-reproduction attempt (IXDE, lenia): two Lenia replicator species on one regrowing food; MIRd+ cells divide to generation 3-8, starve when their own food is cut, and competition with R+ halves their early growth against a matched separate-food twin
summary: eco-lenia2 (world.py) is lab 1's eco-MIRd-Rplus (two Chan catalogue replicators, MIRd+ = species A and R+ = species B, each with its own 3 channels and 15 kernels, matter built only from one shared, diffusing, regrowing food field, plus space exclusion) with a maintenance decay of all matter (0.01) and food regrowth 0.03 so that cells must keep eating; with decay 0.01-0.03 at the old regrowth (0.01) both species crash to extinction. One planted A founder and one planted R+ cluster per seed. A cells divide cleanly (labkit species A: persistent splits 7/13/10, max generation 4/4/3, seeds 0-2; prey-style ledger on A, seed 1: 64 fissions, 15 merges, 26 sibling-safe fissions at 100 t, strict generation 8). Holding the food at 0 in a 12 px disk around one median cell at t=400 kills it (<10% of its matter) in 15-25 t for 4/4 cells (A and B, seeds 0-1) while the same cell in the fed twin keeps 97-99% and the neighbours outside the disk live on. The matched no-interaction twin (each species on its own food field, no exclusion) lets A reach 20 cells at t=120-130 vs 246-322 with competition (3/3 seeds), A averages 27-28 vs 14-19 cells over t=100-400, while B gains 2-5 cells (52.8-63.0 vs 51.1-58.1 over t>=300); decomposition (seeds 0-1): with shared food but no exclusion A is at 21-23 cells at t=200, with both 14-15, separate 33. Founders are planted, so S is not claimed.

claims.statement: In eco-lenia2 (DECAY 0.01, RHO 0.03, 160x160), species-A cells (MIRd+, all descended from one planted founder) are discrete round cells that persist between divisions, divide into two separate daughters repeatedly (labkit species A max generation 4/4/3 on seeds 0/1/2; generation 8 in the seed-1 ledger), die within 15-25 t when their own food is cut while their fed twin persists (seeds 0 and 1), and their competition with species B for the shared food and space changes A's population dynamics: A needs 246-322 t to reach 20 cells against 120-130 t in the matched separate-food twin (3/3 seeds), with a small gain for B.
claims.track: seed 1, species A: the one planted MIRd+ founder and its descendants (ledger/ledA_s1_gen4plus_strip.png shows random generation>=4 divisions of this lineage; pack/seed1 species A max generation 4); the A cell at (116, 99) whose food is cut at t=400 (cuts/cutA_s1.png) belongs to this lineage and grows in competition with B (pack_s1_species.png vs pack_sep_s1_species.png).

controls_run.X: pack_sep/ (seeds 0-1) and pack_sep_s2/ (seed 2): matched no-interaction twin (SEP=1: own food field per species, no exclusion), same grid, duration, seeds; decomp/ (shared food without exclusion, seeds 0-1)
controls_run.E: cuts/cutA_s0.json, cuts/cutA_s1.json (and cuts/cutB_s0.json, cuts/cutB_s1.json): local food cut on one median cell at t=400 with the fed twin run in lockstep

limits: Founders are planted (MIRd+ and R+ are Chan's catalogue replicators: reproduction itself is Chan's, as in lab 1's mcf-MIRd); S is not claimed. Matter is built only from food and decays at 0.01, so the dependence on food is partly by construction; the local cut is the rubric's L4c gate (one cell starves while neighbours keep their food), as in c18's flshell2. Space exclusion is a coded coupling (positive growth x (1 - other's occupancy)); the decomposition shows that food sharing alone also slows A. The X effect is on the growth phase: all arms reach about 30 A cells by t~600; in seed 0 the separate-food twin freezes into a static lattice (A persistent splits stop at t~280) while A keeps dividing to t~870 with competition. B's own lineage is shallow under labkit (max generation 1-2; its catalogue pattern is already a 4-cell cluster and its cells merge/split often), so D is claimed for A only. labkit merge/split for A is 0.64-0.82 (my ledger: 0.23). dt and resolution not varied. Sheets quantized to 256 colours for size. The 7-channel labkit sheet is hard to read; pack_s*_species.png renders the same recorded frames by species.
